name: Segment tracts into multiple bundles using QuickBundles
summary: Splits each tract of a white matter classification (wmc) into a chosen number of sub-bundles with DIPY QuickBundles and outputs a new wmc classification.
description: For each tract in the input classification, runs QuickBundles on its streamlines and adjusts the distance threshold until the requested number of clusters is reached, then writes a new wmc in which every tract is replaced by its numbered sub-bundles. Use it to study within-tract organisation; the tractogram must be the one the classification indexes into.

inputs.description: Source dwi for tractogram. Only used in loading
Whole-brain tractogram the classification indexes into.
White matter classification (wmc) whose tracts are split into sub-bundles.

outputs.description: New white matter classification with each input tract split into number_bundles QuickBundles sub-bundles.

parameters.description: Number of sub-bundles to split each tract into.
